string.text: Can I join your faction? Can I be of any help?

Help? Yeah, considering you managed to find your way here without a guide. I could use more people like you. However, I cannot let you leave the Great Swamps as one of us, just a heads up. So, you still keen?
Yep. I understand.
Alright. You seem to be able to handle yourself quite well. Most of out guys aren't the fighting type, so if they get swamped by mutants, you'll help. Sorry, bad joke. You familar with our goals?
No, fill me in please.

Alright. We are Clear Sky. Our goal is to research and understand the Zone, the rules and logic that governs it's existance. The zone is alive, but it's not any sort of life - it reacts to Stalkers and mutants alike. Once we know how and why the Zone exists, we can start to educate humanity about it.
Gotcha.
Yeah, I've heard already
Great. Your PDA is now tuned to our frequency, and uses our encrytion systems.
Well, I better go start finding out stuff.
Uh, maybe later?
Alright, come back later if you change your mind.
I've got some business to take care of in the rest of the Zone.
I see. You've come to see me about leaving our faction then?
Yeah, thats right. You said I couldn't leave the Swamps as a member of Clear Sky, hence here I am.
True. You understand if I let you leave, you are not to breath a word of our existance to anyone outside of the swamps. Agreed?
Agreed. I fully understand.
Alright, if you ever decide to come back and help us again, I'm sure you'll be able to find us.
Don't worry. If I do, I'll know these swamps like the back of my hand by then.
On second thought, my business can wait. The faction work is more important at the moment right now.
Good. Come back and see me when your ready, if you still need to pursue your business outside of the Swamps.
I will. I'll get back to work now.
Find the Flash Drive: RP-74

Getting parts and plans is difficult here, being out in the middle of nowhere. My best chance to get new stuff is when Lebedev seens some of our guys to the Garbage, and I ask them to pick up a few bits and pieces. By the way, I'm looking for machine gun data. Just a curiosity of mine. If you find any, you'll let me know right?
Find the Flash Drive: GP37

Alright, we've got our hands on some new weapons, thanks to a few 'donations' from somewhere in the big land, only problem is I'm not familar with these weapons. Could you find me some data on them please? Their German made GP37 assault rifles.
Find the Flash Drive: Anomaly Proof Coatings

Ok, this is important. The amount of anomalous activity is causing more casualties for our boys than mutants are. I need some data on how to better apply anomaly proof coatings - and so does Beanpoleve. I've told Lebedev, and hes got several guys out looking for data. Still, another pair of eyes won't hurt at all.
